name: read-swc-ports-count-where
description: A `read` with `form: "count"` (accepted and not published in `reads.forms`) answers the number of things the same read without a page would answer, and nothing else: here the provide ports of every component, after the `members` slice and the `where` filter. The echoes are the read's own.

context.notes: A count takes no `limit` and no `after`, and counts the set one `address` names: an element or a single value is refused `schema-violation`, and so is `addresses`.
